title: Stochastic analysis for the Dirichlet--Ferguson process
summary: We study a Dirichlet--Ferguson process $ζ$ on a general phase space. First we reprove the chaos expansion from Peccati (2008), providing an explicit formula for the kernel functions. Then we proceed with developing a Malliavin calculus for $ζ$. To this end we introduce a gradient, a divergence and a generator which act as linear operators on random variables or random fields and which are linked by some basic formulas such as integration by parts.
